title.zh: 卷420 列傳二百七 韩超 田兴恕 曾璧光 席宝田
title.en: Volume 420 Biographies 207: Han Chao, Tian Xingshu, Ceng Biguang, Xi Baotian
title.raw: 卷420 列傳二百七 韩超 田兴恕 曾璧光 席宝田

sentences.zh: 韓超，字南溪，直隸昌黎人。

translations.literal: Han Chao, courtesy name Nanxi, was a native of Changli in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chao, styled Nanxi, came from Changli in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 道光十四年，副貢。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Daoguang, he received the rank of vice tribute student.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of the Daoguang reign, he qualified as a vice tribute student.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，天津治海防，超詣軍門獻策，事平，獎敘州判。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, when Tianjin was organizing coastal defense, Chao went to the military headquarters to offer strategies; when the affair was settled, he was rewarded with assignment as departmental judge.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, while Tianjin was strengthening coastal defenses, Chao presented plans at army headquarters. After peace was restored, he was commended and assigned the rank of departmental judge.

sentences.zh: 尋以府經歷揀發貴州，歷署三角屯州同、獨山知州。

translations.literal: Soon after he was selected as a prefectural clerk and posted to Guizhou, serving in acting posts as sub-prefect of Sanjiaotun and magistrate of Dushan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon selected as a prefectural clerk and sent to Guizhou, where he served in acting posts as sub-prefect of Sanjiaotun and magistrate of Dushan.

sentences.zh: 獨山多盜，號難治。

translations.literal: Dushan had many bandits and was known as difficult to govern.
translations.idiomatic: Dushan was rife with bandits and had a reputation as hard to govern.

sentences.zh: 超募勇訓練，用土民為鄉導，擒其渠。

translations.literal: Chao recruited braves and trained them, using local tribesmen as guides, and captured their ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: Chao recruited militiamen, drilled them, used local tribesmen as guides, and captured the bandit chiefs.

sentences.zh: 胡林翼守黎平，深倚重之，言之巡撫蔣霨遠，超由是知名。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi was defending Liping and relied on him deeply; he spoke of him to Governor Jiang Yuanyuan, and Chao thereby became well known.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi, defending Liping, came to rely heavily on him and recommended him to Governor Jiang Yuanyuan, and Chao won fame from that time.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，烏沙苗倡亂，超從林翼進剿，馳風雪中，先後斬獲數百人，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, the Miao of Wusha rose in rebellion; Chao followed Linyi in the punitive campaign, riding through wind and snow, and in successive engagements killed or captured several hundred men until the remaining rebels were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng the Wusha Miao rebelled. Chao joined Linyi's punitive campaign, fighting through wind and snow, and in a series of engagements killed or captured hundreds until the remnant bands were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 論功，以知縣用。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed, he was appointed for use as a county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was recommended for appointment as a county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二年，署清江通判。

translations.literal: In the second year he served as acting sub-prefect of Qingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he served as acting sub-prefect of Qingjiang.

sentences.zh: 知黔將亂，捐俸豢勇士八十人，練成勁卒。

translations.literal: Knowing that Guizhou was about to fall into turmoil, he donated his salary to maintain eighty warriors and drilled them into crack troops.
translations.idiomatic: Foreseeing turmoil in Guizhou, he spent his own salary to keep eighty fighting men and trained them into a hardened force.

sentences.zh: 四年，獨山土匪結粵匪內犯，超率兵練迎擊，分軍出賊後，攻其不備，擒賊首楊元保，复深入廣西南丹州境，擊諸匪平之，加同知銜，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, bandits in Dushan joined with Cantonese rebels in an inward raid; Chao led troops and militia to meet them, detached a force to strike from behind the rebels, attacked them unprepared, captured the bandit chief Yang Yuanbao, then advanced deep into Nandan prefecture in Guangxi, struck the various bandits and pacified them, was given the rank of sub-prefect, and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Dushan bandits allied with Cantonese rebels and invaded inland. Chao led troops and militia to meet them, sent a detachment around the enemy's rear, and caught them off guard, capturing the bandit chief Yang Yuanbao. He then pushed deep into Nandan in Guangxi, routed the bandit bands, and was promoted to sub-prefect with the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 桐梓匪楊鳳竄永寧，合黔西匪王三扎巴連陷數城，圍遵義，超馳至，敗賊南關，陣斬王三扎巴，立解城圍。

translations.literal: The Tongzi bandit Yang Feng fled to Yongning, joined with the Qianxi bandit Wang Sanzhaba, and in succession captured several cities and besieged Zunyi; Chao rode post-haste there, defeated the rebels at the South Gate, slew Wang Sanzhaba in battle, and immediately lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: The Tongzi bandit Yang Feng fled to Yongning and joined the Qianxi rebel Wang Sanzhaba; together they took several towns and besieged Zunyi. Chao galloped to the scene, routed the rebels at the South Gate, killed Wang Sanzhaba in battle, and raised the siege at once.

sentences.zh: 复追敗諸葛章司河，擒楊鳳斬之，餘黨盡殲，擢知府。

translations.literal: He again pursued and defeated them at Zhugezhang on the Si River, captured Yang Feng and executed him, exterminated the remaining followers, and was promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued them again, defeated them at Zhugezhang on the Si River, captured and executed Yang Feng, wiped out the remnant bands, and was promoted to prefect.

sentences.zh: 五年，苗亂蔓延，超馳援台拱，解黃平、平越圍；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, as the Miao rebellion spread, Chao rode to relieve Taigong and lifted the sieges of Huangping and Pingyue;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, as the Miao rebellion spread, Chao rushed to relieve Taigong and raised the sieges of Huangping and Pingyue;

sentences.zh: 轉戰至施秉、鎮遠，賊塹山斷道，以阻官軍。

translations.literal: fighting on to Shibing and Zhenyuan, where the rebels dug trenches in the mountains and cut the roads to block the government army.
translations.idiomatic: then fought on to Shibing and Zhenyuan, where the rebels dug mountain trenches and severed the roads to block the government forces.

sentences.zh: 超以孤軍馳突其間，大小數十戰，補石阡知府。

translations.literal: Chao with a lone army charged through among them in several dozen engagements large and small, and was appointed prefect of Shiqian.
translations.idiomatic: Chao drove a lone column through their lines in dozens of battles large and small and was appointed prefect of Shiqian.

sentences.zh: 超性剛直，有膽略，每與上官爭執是非，上官責以勦賊而靳其餉，飢師轉戰，往往求協助於鄰省。

translations.literal: Chao was by nature upright and blunt, with courage and resource; he often disputed right and wrong with his superiors, and his superiors, while charging him to suppress bandits, stinted his pay; his hungry troops fought on the move and often sought aid from neighboring provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Chao was blunt and upright, bold and resourceful. He often argued with his superiors over right and wrong; they ordered him to hunt bandits while withholding his supplies, and his hungry men fought on the march, often begging help from neighboring provinces.

sentences.zh: 四川總督駱秉章、湖北巡撫胡林翼交章論薦，侍郎王茂廕亦疏薦之，詔下巡撫問狀，以道員記名。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor-General Luo Bingzhang and Hubei Governor Hu Linyi submitted successive memorials recommending him; Vice Minister Wang Maoyin also memorialized in his favor; an edict was sent to the governor to inquire into his record, and he was registered by name for a circuit intendant post.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor-General Luo Bingzhang and Hubei Governor Hu Linyi jointly recommended him in memorial after memorial, and Vice Minister Wang Maoyin also urged his promotion. The court ordered the provincial governor to report on his conduct and registered his name for a circuit intendant post.

sentences.zh: 九年，授貴州糧儲道。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed grain intendant of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed grain intendant of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 時苗、教各匪連陷諸郡縣，駐軍卭水汛，扼其中，使苗、教不得合，且遏其下竄湖南之路。

translations.literal: At that time Miao and sectarian rebels in succession captured prefectures and counties; he stationed his army at the Qiongshui garrison, holding the center so that Miao and sectarians could not unite and blocking their route of descent into Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Miao and sectarian rebels were then overrunning prefectures and counties in succession. He camped at the Qiongshui garrison in the center, keeping the Miao and sectarians from joining forces and blocking their path south into Hunan.

sentences.zh: 賊出全力撲之，超約楚軍夾擊，賊大潰。

translations.literal: The rebels threw their full strength against him; Chao arranged with the Chu army for a pincer attack, and the rebels were routed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels threw their full strength at him; Chao coordinated a pincer with the Hunan army, and the rebels broke completely.

sentences.zh: 剿思州響鼓坪，施秉土地坪，鎮遠金鼎𡉫、鋒嚴𡉫、唐家營𡉫諸賊巢，擒賊目張東山、歐光義等，鎮遠所屬皆平。

translations.literal: He suppressed the rebel nests at Xiangguping in Sinan, Tudituping in Shibing, and Jindingnao, Fengyannao, and Tangjiayingnao in Zhenyuan, captured the bandit leaders Zhang Dongshan, Ou Guangyi, and others, and pacified all districts under Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed rebel strongholds at Xiangguping in Sinan, Tudituping in Shibing, and Jindingnao, Fengyannao, and Tangjiayingnao in Zhenyuan, captured bandit chiefs Zhang Dongshan and Ou Guangyi among others, and pacified the whole Zhenyuan region.

sentences.zh: 民團舊以十戶養一壯丁，超因其意稍變通之，官募士而民輸糧；

translations.literal: The militia had formerly been organized on the rule that ten households supported one able-bodied man; Chao, following their intent, made a slight modification: the government recruited the men while the people supplied grain;
translations.idiomatic: Militia had long been raised on the rule that ten households supported one fighting man. Chao adapted the scheme: the government recruited the troops while the people supplied grain;

sentences.zh: 又籍叛產分授降眾、流人，以田代餉；

translations.literal: he also registered rebel property and distributed it to surrendered masses and displaced persons, using land in place of pay;
translations.idiomatic: he also seized rebel estates and allotted them to surrendered rebels and displaced people, paying troops with land instead of silver;

sentences.zh: 行之二年，得兵三千人。

translations.literal: after two years of this practice he had three thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: and within two years had raised a force of three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 自軍興，協餉不至，地方官吏爭抽取釐金以為補助。

translations.literal: Since the outbreak of war, cooperative funds did not arrive, and local officials vied to levy likin as supplements.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war began cooperative subsidies had failed to arrive, and local officials competed to levy likin taxes as makeshift revenue.

sentences.zh: 超建議釐金統一，一抽之後，不復再抽，商無滯累，餉用差給。

translations.literal: Chao proposed unifying the likin: after one levy there would be no second levy, merchants would not be burdened with repeated exactions, and military funds would be roughly sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Chao proposed a unified likin levy: one assessment only, with no repeat collections, so merchants would not be squeezed repeatedly and military funds would be roughly adequate.

sentences.zh: 十年，命幫辦貴州剿匪事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was ordered to assist in managing the suppression of bandits in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was ordered to assist in the Guizhou bandit-suppression campaign.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署按察使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 提督田興恕疏陳超前後戰功，加布政使銜，賜號武勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Commander Tian Xingyu memorialized Chao's successive battle merits; he was given the rank of provincial treasurer and granted the title Wuyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Military Commander Tian Xingyu memorialized Chao's battle record; he was given the rank of provincial treasurer and the title Wuyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 詔予二品頂戴，​​署貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: An edict granted him the second-rank official's cap button and appointment as acting governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him the second-rank cap button and appointment as acting governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 田興恕方以欽差大臣督辦軍務，超久在行間，亦以肅清全黔為己任。

translations.literal: Tian Xingyu was then serving as imperial commissioner supervising military affairs; Chao had long been in the ranks and likewise took the pacification of all Guizhou as his own duty.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xingyu was then imperial commissioner in charge of military affairs; Chao had long served in the field and likewise made the pacification of all Guizhou his personal mission.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，田興恕罷，乃命超辦理防剿事宜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, Tian Xingyu was dismissed, and Chao was ordered to manage defense and suppression affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, after Tian Xingyu was dismissed, Chao was ordered to take charge of defense and bandit suppression.

sentences.zh: 時尚大坪、玉華山兩處為賊巢，遵義、安順、思南、大定、銅仁、石阡諸府所在皆賊，五月，回匪陷興義，雲南叛回潰勇擾境，粵匪亦由川竄至正陽、廟堂並桐梓、松坎諸地。

translations.literal: At that time Shangdaping and Yuhuashan were two bandit nests; Zunyi, Anshun, Sinan, Dading, Tongren, Shiqian, and other prefectures were overrun with bandits. In the fifth month Hui rebels captured Xingyi; rebel Hui rout troops from Yunnan harassed the borders; Cantonese bandits also fled from Sichuan into Zhengyang, Miaotang, Tongzi, Songkan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdaping and Yuhuashan were then the main rebel nests, and bandits held sway across Zunyi, Anshun, Sinan, Dading, Tongren, Shiqian, and other prefectures. In the fifth month Hui rebels took Xingyi; routed Yunnan Hui rebels raided the border; and Cantonese bandits fled from Sichuan into Zhengyang, Miaotang, Tongzi, Songkan, and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 超令總兵吳安康進剿，用內應夜縱火攻破賊巢，擒匪首倪老帽斬之，出難民二千餘人。

translations.literal: Chao ordered Brigadier Wu Ankang to advance in suppression; using inside collaborators they set fire by night and stormed the bandit nest, captured the bandit chief Ni Laomao and executed him, and freed more than two thousand refugees.
translations.idiomatic: Chao ordered Brigadier Wu Ankang to attack. With inside help they set the nest ablaze at night, stormed it, captured and executed the bandit chief Ni Laomao, and freed more than two thousand civilians.

sentences.zh: 六月，閔家場踞賊糾集苗、教諸黨偪江口，天柱匪首亦糾合土匪攻陷縣城，分股竄湖南晃州廳、高寨，陷卭水、青谿兩城，謀截楚軍糧道。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, bandits entrenched at Minjiachang gathered Miao and sectarian factions to press on Jiangkou; the Tianzhu bandit chief also rallied local bandits, captured the county seat, split into columns that raided Huangzhou subprefecture and Gaozhai in Hunan, took the two cities of Qiongshui and Qingxi, and plotted to cut the Chu army's grain route.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month rebels at Minjiachang rallied Miao and sectarian bands against Jiangkou. The Tianzhu bandit chief joined local bandits, took the county seat, sent columns into Hunan's Huangzhou subprefecture and Gaozhai, captured Qiongshui and Qingxi, and aimed to sever the Hunan army's supply line.

sentences.zh: 超令總兵羅孝連、道員趙國澍進攻安順仲匪，夷其壘，擒斬賊酋韋登鳳等。

translations.literal: Chao ordered Brigadier Luo Xiaolian and Circuit Intendant Zhao Guoshu to attack the Zhong bandits of Anshun, razed their stockades, and captured and executed the bandit chiefs Wei Dengfeng and others.
translations.idiomatic: Chao sent Brigadier Luo Xiaolian and Circuit Intendant Zhao Guoshu against the Zhong rebels of Anshun. They leveled the stockades and captured and executed the chiefs Wei Dengfeng and others.

sentences.zh: 尚大坪賊复約苗、教分掠江內，超令孝連斷其歸路，國澍等馳軍迎擊，復令副將趙德元出冷水河、梯子岩進襲尚大坪，立破之，卬水汛城同時克復。

translations.literal: The Shangdaping bandits again allied with Miao and sectarians to plunder within the river region; Chao ordered Xiaolian to cut off their retreat, Guoshu and others rode out to meet them, and further ordered Deputy Commander Zhao Deyuan to advance from Lengshuihe and Tiziyan against Shangdaping, which was immediately broken; the Qiongshui garrison city was recovered at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdaping rebels again allied with Miao and sectarians to raid the river districts. Chao had Xiaolian cut their retreat while Guoshu and others struck them head-on, and sent Deputy Commander Zhao Deyuan through Lengshuihe and Tiziyan against Shangdaping. The nest fell at once, and the Qiongshui garrison was retaken the same day.

sentences.zh: 進平玉華山賊巢，攻拔瓦寨，复天柱縣城，特詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: Advancing, he pacified the Yuhuashan bandit nest, stormed Wazhai, and recovered the Tianzhu county seat; a special edict praised his achievement.
translations.idiomatic: He then cleared the Yuhuashan nest, stormed Wazhai, and recovered Tianzhu county seat, earning a special imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 道員鄧爾巽、總兵李有恆，破王家苗寨、夾馬洞諸賊巢，獲其酋李玉榮等。

translations.literal: Circuit Intendant Deng Erxun and Brigadier Li Youheng broke the bandit nests at Wangjia Miao stockade and Jiama Cave and captured their chiefs Li Yurong and others.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit Intendant Deng Erxun and Brigadier Li Youheng stormed the nests at Wangjia Miao stockade and Jiama Cave and captured chiefs including Li Yurong.

sentences.zh: 黃、白號，教匪竄遵義，知府李德莪擊破之於三台山，奪五里坎諸隘口。

translations.literal: The Yellow- and White-Banner sectarian bandits fled into Zunyi; Prefect Li De'e defeated them at Santaishan and seized the passes at Wulikan and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow- and White-Banner sectarian rebels fled into Zunyi; Prefect Li De'e routed them at Santaishan and recaptured the passes at Wulikan and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 副將周宏順進攻石阡，毀老王𡉫賊巢，諸𡉫就撫。

translations.literal: Deputy Commander Zhou Hongshun attacked Shiqian, destroyed the Laowangnao bandit nest, and the various naos submitted to pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commander Zhou Hongshun attacked Shiqian, destroyed the Laowangnao nest, and the surrounding strongholds surrendered.

sentences.zh: 石阡、銅仁苗匪攻毀鎮遠營壘，卭水戍軍亦潰，遂南掠松桃，北攻天柱。

translations.literal: Miao bandits of Shiqian and Tongren attacked and destroyed the Zhenyuan camp fortifications; the Qiongshui garrison also collapsed, then raided south into Songtao and attacked north toward Tianzhu.
translations.idiomatic: Miao rebels from Shiqian and Tongren wrecked the Zhenyuan camps; the Qiongshui garrison broke as well, then raided south into Songtao and struck north at Tianzhu.

sentences.zh: 湖南援師至，賊始引去。

translations.literal: When Hunan relief troops arrived, the bandits only then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Only when Hunan relief troops arrived did the rebels withdraw.

sentences.zh: 詔斥超專恃援軍，有負疆寄。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Chao for relying exclusively on relief troops and failing his frontier commission.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Chao for relying solely on outside reinforcements and betraying his frontier charge.

sentences.zh: 雲南方議撫回，巡撫徐之銘諮會停剿，而回匪益恣，竄陷安南、興義，分擾郎岱、永寧、歸化，詔原其誤信撫議，免議處。

translations.literal: Yunnan was then debating pacification of the Hui; Governor Xu Zhiming consulted and halted suppression, but the Hui bandits grew more unrestrained, fled in raids to capture Annan and Xingyi, and split forces to harass Langdai, Yongning, and Guihua; an edict excused his mistaken trust in the pacification proposal and exempted him from disciplinary action.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan was debating Hui pacification; Governor Xu Zhiming consulted and halted suppression, but the Hui rebels grew bolder, raided Annan and Xingyi, and spread into Langdai, Yongning, and Guihua. An edict forgave his mistaken faith in pacification and spared him punishment.

sentences.zh: 石達開自川回竄，分三路，一走遵義，一走黔西，一走桐梓。

translations.literal: Shi Dakai fled back from Sichuan, dividing into three routes: one toward Zunyi, one toward Qianxi, and one toward Tongzi.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Dakai fled back from Sichuan in three columns: one toward Zunyi, one toward Qianxi, and one toward Tongzi.

sentences.zh: 遣沈宏富、李有恆、余祖凱擊之。

translations.literal: He dispatched Shen Hongfu, Li Youheng, and Yu Zukai to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Shen Hongfu, Li Youheng, and Yu Zukai against them.

sentences.zh: 田興恕以教案獲譴去官，黔軍益單。

translations.literal: Tian Xingyu was punished and removed from office over the missionary case, and the Guizhou army grew still thinner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xingyu was punished and dismissed over the missionary case, leaving the Guizhou army still weaker.

sentences.zh: 二年，乞病回籍。

translations.literal: In the second year he begged leave on grounds of illness and returned to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，卒於家，年七十有九。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu he died at home, aged seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu he died at home at the age of seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 詔念前功，賜卹，諡果靖。

translations.literal: An edict recalled his former merit, granted funeral honors, and gave the posthumous title Guojing.
translations.idiomatic: The court recalled his earlier service, granted funeral honors, and gave him the posthumous title Guojing.

sentences.zh: 貴州請建專祠，並附祀胡林翼祠。

translations.literal: Guizhou requested a dedicated shrine for him and that he be enshrined alongside Hu Linyi's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou petitioned for a shrine in his honor and for him to be worshipped in Hu Linyi's temple as well.

sentences.zh: 田興恕，字忠普，湖南鎮筸人。

translations.literal: Tian Xingyu, courtesy name Zhongpu, was a native of Zhengan in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xingyu, styled Zhongpu, came from Zhengan in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 年十六，充行伍，隸鎮筸鎮標。

translations.literal: At age sixteen he entered the ranks and served under the Zhengan garrison standard.
translations.idiomatic: At sixteen he joined the army and served in the Zhengan garrison.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，從守長沙。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he followed in the defense of Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he took part in the defense of Changsha.

sentences.zh: 賊屯湘江西岸，軍中募敢死士夜驚賊營，興恕請行，夜浮小舟往，潛燔賊營，賊騎數百追之，泅水免。

translations.literal: The rebels were encamped on the west bank of the Xiang River; the army recruited dare-to-die men to harass the rebel camp by night; Xingyu volunteered, floated a small boat across by night, secretly set fire to the rebel camp, was pursued by several hundred rebel horsemen, and escaped by swimming.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held the west bank of the Xiang. The army recruited volunteers for a night raid; Xingyu volunteered, crossed by small boat after dark, set the rebel camp ablaze, was chased by hundreds of horsemen, and swam to safety.

sentences.zh: 巡撫駱秉章奇之，委充哨官。

translations.literal: Governor Luo Bingzhang marveled at him and appointed him a platoon officer.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Luo Bingzhang was impressed and appointed him a platoon officer.

sentences.zh: 五年，從克郴州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed in the capture of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he took part in capturing Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，領五百人號虎威營。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he led five hundred men in a unit called the Tiger Might Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he commanded five hundred men in the Tiger Might Battalion.

sentences.zh: 從蕭啟江援江西，克萬載、袁州。

translations.literal: He followed Xiao Qijiang to relieve Jiangxi and captured Wanzai and Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Xiao Qijiang to relieve Jiangxi and helped capture Wanzai and Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年，戰上高英岡嶺，深入被圍，左手受創，亡馬，步戰，他將馳救，得免。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he fought at Yinggangling in Shanggao, advanced deep and was surrounded, was wounded in the left hand, lost his horse, fought on foot, and was rescued when another commander rode to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he fought at Yinggangling in Shanggao, pushed too far and was surrounded, took a wound to the left hand, lost his horse, fought on foot, and was saved when another commander rode to rescue him.

sentences.zh: 是役以少擊眾，斃賊千數。

translations.literal: In that battle, with few against many, he killed rebels by the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In that fight his outnumbered force killed rebels by the thousands.

sentences.zh: 進攻臨江，掘地道轟城，先登，再被創，賊死拒未下。

translations.literal: Advancing against Linjiang, they dug a tunnel to blast the wall; he was first to scale, was wounded again, and the rebels resisted to the death without yielding the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Linjiang they mined the walls; he was first over the breach, was wounded again, but the rebels held on and the city did not fall.

sentences.zh: 援賊大至，啟江議暫退，興恕不可，曰：「兵在精不在多，原為前鋒。

translations.literal: Rebel reinforcements arrived in force; Qijiang proposed a temporary withdrawal, but Xingyu would not agree, saying: "Troops depend on quality, not numbers; I was made the vanguard for this purpose.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel reinforcements arrived in force. Qijiang proposed pulling back, but Xingyu refused, saying, "Victory depends on quality, not numbers. I was sent to lead the van.

sentences.zh: 」率所部直貫賊陣，賊張左右翼圍之，後軍望見興恕旗指東麾西，賊皆披靡，夾擊，賊大敗竄走，遂復臨江。

translations.literal: " He led his command straight through the rebel formation; the rebels spread left and right wings to surround him; the rear army saw Xingyu's banner point east while he commanded west, the rebels all broke and scattered, a pincer attack followed, the rebels were routed and fled, and Linjiang was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: " He drove his men straight through the rebel line. The enemy spread wings to surround him, but the rear ranks saw Xingyu's banner feint east while he struck west; the rebels broke, a pincer crushed them, and Linjiang was retaken.

sentences.zh: 八年，克崇仁、樂安、宜黃、南豐，積功至副將，加總兵銜，賜號尚勇、摯勇兩巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he captured Chongren, Le'an, Yihuang, and Nanfeng; for accumulated merit he rose to deputy commander, was given the rank of brigadier, and was granted the titles Shangyong and Zhiyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he captured Chongren, Le'an, Yihuang, and Nanfeng. For accumulated merit he was promoted to deputy commander with brigadier's rank and granted the titles Shangyong and Zhiyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 貴州苗、教匪熾，黎平府被圍久。

translations.literal: Miao and sectarian bandits in Guizhou were fierce, and Liping prefecture had long been besieged.
translations.idiomatic: Miao and sectarian rebels raged in Guizhou, and Liping had been under siege for a long time.

sentences.zh: 興恕奉檄赴援，至即攻破賊營，連戰三日而圍解，進克古州、永從，署古州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Xingyu received orders to go to the relief; on arrival he immediately stormed the rebel camp, fought three days in succession until the siege was lifted, advanced to capture Guzhou and Yongcong, and served as acting commander of the Guzhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to the relief, Xingyu stormed the rebel camp on arrival, fought three days straight until the siege lifted, then took Guzhou and Yongcong and served as acting commander of the Guzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 九年，石達開圍寶慶，興恕率四千五百人赴援，扼九鞏橋，無日不戰，歷月餘，糧藥將罄，選死士欲以一戰決勝負，會李續宜援軍至，內外夾擊，毀附城營三，連日攻下，勢如破竹。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Shi Dakai besieged Baojing; Xingyu led forty-five hundred men to the relief, held Jiugong Bridge, fought every day for more than a month until grain and ammunition were nearly exhausted, selected dare-to-die men intending to settle the issue in one battle; then Li Xuyi's relief army arrived, inner and outer forces struck in concert, destroyed three camps adjoining the city, took them in successive days' assault, and the momentum was like splitting bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Shi Dakai besieged Baojing. Xingyu led forty-five hundred men to hold Jiugong Bridge and fought daily for more than a month until supplies ran low. He picked volunteers for a decisive battle, then Li Xuyi's relief force arrived. Inner and outer columns struck together, destroyed three camps by the walls, and swept the rest aside in days.

sentences.zh: 達開竄廣西，遂移軍靖州防黔邊，命署貴州提督，督辦貴州軍務，增軍盈二萬。

translations.literal: Dakai fled into Guangxi; Xingyu then shifted his army to Jingzhou to guard the Guizhou border, was ordered to serve as acting provincial military commander of Guizhou and to supervise Guizhou military affairs, and increased his army to more than twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Dakai fled into Guangxi. Xingyu moved his army to Jingzhou to guard the Guizhou border, was appointed acting provincial military commander of Guizhou with charge of military affairs, and expanded his force to more than twenty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 十年，道銅仁，取印江，分軍略思南、石阡，進克貓貓山賊巢。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he marched through Tongren, took Yinjiang, detached forces to overrun Sinan and Shiqian, and advanced to capture the Maomaoshan bandit nest.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he marched through Tongren, took Yinjiang, sent columns into Sinan and Shiqian, and captured the Maomaoshan bandit nest.

sentences.zh: 石達開由廣西入貴州，連陷數縣，省城大震。

translations.literal: Shi Dakai entered Guizhou from Guangxi, captured several counties in succession, and the provincial capital was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Dakai entered Guizhou from Guangxi, overran several counties in succession, and threw the provincial capital into alarm.

sentences.zh: 巡撫劉源灝趣赴援，興恕奏言：「黔省上游道路分歧，賊若以一軍擾黔，一軍入蜀，道遠兵單，斷難兼顧。

translations.literal: Governor Liu Yuanhao urged him to hurry to the relief; Xingyu memorialized: "In the upper reaches of Guizhou the roads diverge; if the rebels send one army to harass Guizhou and one into Sichuan, with long distances and few troops it will certainly be impossible to cover both.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Liu Yuanhao urged him to hurry to the relief. Xingyu memorialized: "In upper Guizhou the roads fork. If the rebels send one column against Guizhou and another into Sichuan, our few troops over such distances cannot cover both.

sentences.zh: 已檄韓超防鎮遠，沈宏富守湄潭，劉義方進松桃，臣駐石阡，居中調度。

translations.literal: I have already ordered Han Chao to defend Zhenyuan, Shen Hongfu to hold Meitan, Liu Yifang to advance on Songtao, and I myself am stationed at Shiqian to direct affairs from the center.
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered Han Chao to hold Zhenyuan, Shen Hongfu to hold Meitan, and Liu Yifang to advance on Songtao, while I remain at Shiqian to coordinate from the center.

sentences.zh: 賊如上竄，則親會川軍以攻之；

translations.literal: If the rebels flee upward, I will personally join the Sichuan army to attack them;
translations.idiomatic: If they flee north, I will join the Sichuan army in person;

sentences.zh: 窺楚，即馳還靖州。

translations.literal: if they threaten Chu, I will ride post-haste back to Jingzhou."
translations.idiomatic: if they threaten Hunan, I will ride back to Jingzhou at once."

sentences.zh: 」時興恕已實授提督，詔授欽差大臣，命援省城。

translations.literal: " By then Xingyu had received substantive appointment as provincial military commander; an edict appointed him imperial commissioner and ordered him to relieve the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: " By then Xingyu had been confirmed as provincial military commander. An edict made him imperial commissioner and ordered him to relieve the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 師至，部署省防，督軍赴定番迎剿，賊棄城而走。

translations.literal: When his army arrived he deployed the provincial defenses, directed troops to Dingfan to meet and suppress the rebels, and the rebels abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When his army arrived he organized the capital's defenses, sent troops to Dingfan to meet the rebels, and the enemy abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 十一年，兼署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he also served as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he also served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 時回、仲、苗、教諸匪分擾，上下游幾無完土。

translations.literal: At that time Hui, Zhong, Miao, and sectarian bandits raided in separate bands, and upstream and downstream there was scarcely an intact district.
translations.idiomatic: Hui, Zhong, Miao, and sectarian rebels raided in bands up and down the province until scarcely a district remained intact.

sentences.zh: 興恕分兵援剿，戰屢捷。

translations.literal: Xingyu detached troops for relief and suppression and won repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyu sent columns to relieve and suppress them and won battle after battle.

sentences.zh: 招撫匪首唐天佑、賈福保、陳大六、柳天成等，克復歸化、荔波、定番、廣順、獨山諸城，疏通驛路，軍威漸振。

translations.literal: He won over the bandit chiefs Tang Tianyou, Jia Fubao, Chen Daliu, Liu Tiancheng, and others, recovered the cities of Guihua, Libo, Dingfan, Guangshun, and Dushan, cleared the post roads, and military prestige gradually revived.
translations.idiomatic: He won over bandit chiefs Tang Tianyou, Jia Fubao, Chen Daliu, Liu Tiancheng, and others, recovered Guihua, Libo, Dingfan, Guangshun, and Dushan, reopened the post roads, and gradually restored the army's prestige.

sentences.zh: 興恕年甫二十有四，驟膺疆寄，恃功而驕，又不諳文法，左右用事，屢被論劾，乃罷兼職，以韓超代之。

translations.literal: Xingyu was only twenty-four years old, had suddenly received a frontier commission, relied on his merit and grew arrogant, was also unversed in bureaucratic law, and let his attendants wield power; he was repeatedly impeached, and therefore his concurrent post was removed and Han Chao replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyu was only twenty-four, had suddenly been given a frontier command, grew arrogant on his victories, knew little of bureaucratic procedure, and let his aides run affairs. After repeated impeachments his concurrent governorship was revoked and Han Chao replaced him.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，罷欽差大臣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was dismissed as imperial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was dismissed as imperial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會法國教士文乃爾傳教入黔，因事齟齬，興恕惡其倔強，殺之，坐褫職，赴四川聽候查辦。

translations.literal: It happened that the French missionary Wen Nai'er entered Guizhou to preach; because of a dispute Xingyu hated his obstinacy and killed him; he was punished by removal from office and went to Sichuan to await investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The French missionary Wen Nai'er entered Guizhou to preach; after a dispute Xingyu, angered by his defiance, had him killed. He was stripped of office and sent to Sichuan to await trial.

sentences.zh: 經遵義旺超，值雲貴總督勞崇光為賊所困。

translations.literal: Passing through Wangchao in Zunyi, he found Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Luo Chongguang besieged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through Wangchao in Zunyi, he found Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Luo Chongguang trapped by bandits.

sentences.zh: 興恕驟馬衝入，大呼：「田某在此！

translations.literal: Xingyu spurred his horse and charged in, shouting loudly: "Tian is here!
translations.idiomatic: Xingyu spurred his horse into the fight, shouting, "Tian is here!

sentences.zh: 」賊驚潰，翼崇光出。

translations.literal: " The bandits fled in alarm, and he escorted Chongguang out.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits broke and fled, and he escorted Chongguang to safety.

sentences.zh: 尋論罪遣戍新疆，行至甘肅，總督左宗棠奏請留防秦州。

translations.literal: Soon he was sentenced and banished to Xinjiang; reaching Gansu, Governor-General Zuo Zongtang memorialized asking that he be kept to defend Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sentenced to exile in Xinjiang. Reaching Gansu, Governor-General Zuo Zongtang petitioned to keep him for defense at Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二年，釋歸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was released and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was released and allowed to return home.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Guangxu he died at home.

sentences.zh: 曾璧光，字樞垣，四川洪雅人。

translations.literal: Zeng Biguang, courtesy name Shuyuan, was a native of Hongya in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Biguang, styled Shuyuan, came from Hongya in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 道光三十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，記名御史。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, appointed compiler, and registered by name for the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and was registered for promotion to the censorate.

sentences.zh: 入直上書房，授恭親王奕訢、醇郡王奕枻讀。

translations.literal: He entered service in the Upper Study and instructed Prince Gong Yixin and Prince Chun Yiyi in reading.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Upper Study and tutored Prince Gong Yixin and Prince Chun Yiyi.

sentences.zh: 咸豐九年，出為貴州鎮遠知府。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he went out to serve as prefect of Zhenyuan in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he was appointed prefect of Zhenyuan in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，署貴東道。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he served as acting eastern Guizhou circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he served as acting eastern Guizhou circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 二年，剿平銅仁踞賊蕭文魁，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the second year he suppressed the entrenched Tongren bandit Xiao Wenkui and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he suppressed the Tongren bandit Xiao Wenkui and was granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 雲貴總督勞崇光薦其才，迭署糧道、按察使、布政使。

translations.literal: Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Luo Chongguang recommended his talent, and he served in succession as acting grain intendant, provincial judicial commissioner, and provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Luo Chongguang recommended his ability, and he served in succession as acting grain intendant, judicial commissioner, and provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 六年，予二品頂戴，​​署貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was granted the second-rank cap button and served as acting governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he received the second-rank cap button and served as acting governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 七年，實授。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he received substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he received substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 貴州地瘠亂久，北境接四川，東境接湖南，軍事悉倚鄰援，​​本省餉既艱窘，將多驕蹇。

translations.literal: Guizhou's land was poor and turmoil had lasted long; its northern border adjoined Sichuan and its eastern border Hunan; military affairs all relied on neighboring aid; the province's funds were already strained, and many commanders were arrogant and refractory.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou was poor and had been at war for years. Its northern border touched Sichuan and its eastern border Hunan, so military affairs depended entirely on outside help. Provincial funds were exhausted, and many commanders were arrogant and ungovernable.

sentences.zh: 總兵林自清劾罷後，戕興義縣令，率所部萬人擾川境。

translations.literal: After Brigadier Lin Ziqing was impeached and dismissed, he killed the magistrate of Xingyi, led his ten thousand followers to harass the Sichuan border.
translations.idiomatic: After Brigadier Lin Ziqing was impeached and dismissed, he killed the magistrate of Xingyi and led his ten thousand men to raid the Sichuan border.

sentences.zh: 八年，璧光密遣提督陳希祥擒斬之，令吳宗蘭剿青山餘匪，克普安、安南。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Biguang secretly dispatched Provincial Military Commander Chen Xixiang to capture and execute him, ordered Wu Zonglan to suppress the remnant bandits at Qingshan, and captured Pu'an and Annan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Biguang secretly sent Provincial Military Commander Chen Xixiang to capture and execute Lin, ordered Wu Zonglan to clear remnant bandits at Qingshan, and recovered Pu'an and Annan.

sentences.zh: 時席寶田軍已由東路進規台拱，省城附近諸匪糅雜，出沒無常。

translations.literal: At that time Xi Baotian's army had already advanced from the eastern route toward Taigong; the various bandits near the provincial capital were mixed together and appeared and vanished without pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Baotian's army was already advancing from the east toward Taigong, while mixed rebel bands near the capital raided unpredictably.

sentences.zh: 九年，周達武調任貴州提督，率川軍至貴陽，漸次勘定。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Zhou Dawu was transferred to serve as provincial military commander of Guizhou, led the Sichuan army to Guiyang, and gradually pacified the province.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Zhou Dawu was transferred as Guizhou provincial military commander, brought Sichuan troops to Guiyang, and gradually pacified the province.

sentences.zh: 自軍興鄉試久停，至是年始補行，人心益定。

translations.literal: Since the outbreak of war the provincial examination had long been suspended; only in this year was it held as a make-up, and popular sentiment grew more settled.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial civil service examination had been suspended since the war began; only now was it held as a make-up, and public morale steadied.

sentences.zh: 與達武議增兵扼要駐守，令道員蹇訚破遵義賊，擒其酋吳三；

translations.literal: He discussed with Dawu increasing troops to hold strategic points, ordered Circuit Intendant Jian Yin to defeat the Zunyi bandits and capture their chief Wu San;
translations.idiomatic: He and Dawu agreed to reinforce key posts, ordered Circuit Intendant Jian Yin to defeat the Zunyi rebels and capture their chief Wu San;

sentences.zh: 令提督劉士奇克都勻，殪其酋吳章。

translations.literal: and ordered Provincial Military Commander Liu Shiji to capture Duyun and destroy its chief Wu Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: and ordered Provincial Military Commander Liu Shiji to take Duyun and kill its chief Wu Zhang.

sentences.zh: 十年，令提督鍾有思等進剿上游，克永寧、威寧，下游諸軍擒悍賊潘得洪，收復八寨等城。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he ordered Provincial Military Commander Zhong Yousi and others to advance in suppression upriver, captured Yongning and Weining, and downstream armies captured the fierce bandit Pan Dehong and recovered Bazhai and other cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he sent Provincial Military Commander Zhong Yousi and others upriver, took Yongning and Weining, while downstream forces captured the fierce bandit Pan Dehong and recovered Bazhai and other towns.

sentences.zh: 又收復上江、下江、三腳各城，平上游鎮寧、歸化賊巢，殪永城踞賊侯大五，斬郎岱金家硐踞賊金大七，盤江北岸肅清。

translations.literal: He also recovered the cities of Shangjiang, Xiajiang, and Sanjiao, pacified the bandit nests of Zhenning and Guihua upriver, destroyed the entrenched Yongcheng bandit Hou Dawu, executed the entrenched Langdai bandit Jin Daqi at the Jin family cave, and cleared the north bank of the Pan River.
translations.idiomatic: He also recovered Shangjiang, Xiajiang, and Sanjiao, cleared rebel nests at Zhenning and Guihua upriver, killed the Yongcheng rebel Hou Dawu, executed the Langdai rebel Jin Daqi at the Jin family cave, and pacified the north bank of the Pan River.

sentences.zh: 又破畢節、威寧諸匪，清八寨、三角餘賊，毀其巢。

translations.literal: He again defeated the bandits of Bijie and Weining, cleared the remnant bandits of Bazhai and Sanjiao, and destroyed their nests.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated bandits in Bijie and Weining, cleared remnant rebels in Bazhai and Sanjiao, and destroyed their strongholds.

sentences.zh: 令總兵何世華擊斬安南賊酋潘么，進克貞豐，西路悉平。

translations.literal: He ordered Brigadier He Shihua to strike and kill the Annan bandit chief Pan Yao, advanced to capture Zhenfeng, and the western route was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Brigadier He Shihua to kill the Annan bandit chief Pan Yao, advanced to take Zhenfeng, and the western front was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 十一年，周達武率所部會楚軍定苗疆，詔嘉調度有方，予優敘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Zhou Dawu led his command in concert with the Chu army to pacify the Miao frontier; an edict praised his skillful coordination and granted him preferential promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Zhou Dawu joined the Hunan army to pacify the Miao frontier. An edict praised his coordination and granted him preferential promotion.

sentences.zh: 十二年，會滇軍克新城老巢，全省肅清，加太子少保、頭品頂戴，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, joining the Yunnan army, he captured the old nest at Xincheng; the whole province was pacified; he was given the titles Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and first-rank cap button, and granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, with the Yunnan army, he took the old nest at Xincheng and pacified the whole province. He was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the first-rank cap button and granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 尋新城防軍索餉譁變，匪首何玉亭攻新城，遣其黨黎正關攻興義，分軍馳剿，捕誅其渠，事旋定。

translations.literal: Soon the Xincheng garrison mutinied demanding pay; the bandit chief He Yuting attacked Xincheng and sent his follower Li Zhengguan to attack Xingyi; detached troops rode in suppression, captured and executed the ringleaders, and the affair was soon settled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Xincheng garrison mutinied over pay. Bandit chief He Yuting attacked Xincheng and sent Li Zhengguan against Xingyi. Dispatched columns crushed the leaders, and order was quickly restored.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，卒於官，追贈太子太保，依總督例賜卹，諡文誠。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he died in office; posthumously he was given the title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, funeral honors according to the governor-general precedent, and the posthumous title Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu he died in office. Posthumously he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given governor-general funeral honors, and granted the posthumous title Wencheng.

sentences.zh: 四川、貴州請建專祠。

translations.literal: Sichuan and Guizhou petitioned for dedicated shrines in his honor.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan and Guizhou petitioned for shrines in his honor.

sentences.zh: 席寶田，字研薌，湖南東安人。

translations.literal: Xi Baotian, courtesy name Yanxiang, was a native of Dong'an in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Baotian, styled Yanxiang, came from Dong'an in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 諸生。

translations.literal: He was a licentiate.
translations.idiomatic: He was a licentiate.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，率鄉團殺賊，复縣城，獎敘訓導。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he led a local militia to kill bandits, recovered the county seat, and was rewarded with assignment as an instructor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he led a local militia against bandits, recovered the county seat, and was commended with assignment as an instructor.

sentences.zh: 六年，劉長佑援江西，招參軍事，遂從轉戰，積功累擢同知直隸州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Liu Changyou went to relieve Jiangxi, recruited him to assist in military affairs, and he followed in successive campaigns, rising by accumulated merit to sub-prefect of Zhili prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Liu Changyou went to relieve Jiangxi, recruited him as a military aide, and he fought through successive campaigns until merit raised him to sub-prefect of Zhili prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年，石達開由廣西犯湖南，寶田從解寶慶圍，擢知府。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Shi Dakai invaded Hunan from Guangxi; Baotian followed in lifting the siege of Baojing and was promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Shi Dakai invaded Hunan from Guangxi. Baotian helped lift the siege of Baojing and was promoted to prefect.

sentences.zh: 十年，駱秉章令募千人號精毅營，防湖南邊。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Luo Bingzhang ordered him to recruit a thousand men in a unit called the Elite Resolution Battalion to guard the Hunan border.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Luo Bingzhang had him recruit a thousand men into the Elite Resolution Battalion to guard the Hunan border.

sentences.zh: 廣東賊犯郴州、桂陽，擊走之。

translations.literal: Cantonese bandits invaded Chenzhou and Guiyang; he drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Cantonese bandits invaded Chenzhou and Guiyang; he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，石達開復由廣西入境，連敗之於黔陽，克來鳳，以道員記名，加按察使銜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Shi Dakai again entered from Guangxi; Baotian defeated him repeatedly at Qianyang, captured Laifeng, was registered by name for a circuit intendant post, and was given the rank of provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi Shi Dakai again entered from Guangxi. Baotian defeated him repeatedly at Qianyang, took Laifeng, was registered for a circuit intendant post, and was given provincial judicial commissioner's rank.

sentences.zh: 二年，粵匪黃文金大舉犯江西，命提督江忠義赴援，寶田副之，戰饒州桃溪渡，大破之；

translations.literal: In the second year the Cantonese bandit Huang Wenjin invaded Jiangxi in force; Provincial Military Commander Jiang Zhongyi was ordered to the relief with Baotian as his deputy; they fought at Taoxidu in Raozhou and inflicted a great defeat;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the Cantonese rebel Huang Wenjin invaded Jiangxi in force. Provincial Military Commander Jiang Zhongyi was sent to relieve the province with Baotian as deputy. At Taoxidu in Raozhou they won a crushing victory;

sentences.zh: 又迭破之於湖口、洋塘、石門、青山橋，賊引去，趨池州，圍青陽。

translations.literal: they again defeated him in succession at Hukou, Yangtang, Shimen, and Qingshan Bridge; the bandits withdrew, headed toward Chizhou, and besieged Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: then defeated him again at Hukou, Yangtang, Shimen, and Qingshan Bridge. The rebels withdrew toward Chizhou and besieged Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 寶田襲石嶺，破賊卡，分軍遮其前，命水陸夾擊，文金遁走，遂解青陽圍，累功賜號業鏗額巴圖魯，加布政使銜。

translations.literal: Baotian raided Shiling, broke the bandit stockade, detached troops to block their front, ordered a joint land-and-water attack, Wenjin fled, the siege of Qingyang was lifted, and for accumulated merit he was granted the title Yekenge Batulu and the rank of provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: Baotian raided Shiling, stormed the rebel stockade, blocked their front with a detachment, and ordered a joint land-and-water attack. Wenjin fled, the siege of Qingyang was raised, and for accumulated merit he received the title Yekenge Batulu and provincial treasurer's rank.

sentences.zh: 江忠義卒於軍，寶田代領其眾，留防江西。

translations.literal: Jiang Zhongyi died in the army; Baotian took command of his forces in his stead and remained to defend Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhongyi died in camp; Baotian took over his command and remained to defend Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 三年，李世賢、黃文金復合犯江西，將以遙掣江寧之師，寶田逆擊白沙關，奪梘橋要隘，鈔擊於大濟關、泥嶺關，賊竄山谷，復金谿，以按察使記名，授雲南按察使。

translations.literal: In the third year Li Shixian and Huang Wenjin again jointly invaded Jiangxi, intending to pin down the Jiangning army from afar; Baotian met them at Baishaguan, seized the strategic pass at Jiqiao, struck at Dajiguan and Nilingguan, the bandits fled into the mountains, Jinxii was recovered, he was registered by name as provincial judicial commissioner, and was appointed provincial judicial commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Li Shixian and Huang Wenjin again invaded Jiangxi to tie down the Nanjing army. Baotian met them at Baishaguan, seized Jiqiao pass, struck at Dajiguan and Nilingguan, drove the rebels into the hills, recovered Jinxii, was registered as judicial commissioner, and was appointed judicial commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 時楊岳斌初至江西督辦軍務，檄寶田援南豐，坐遷延被劾，降知府，留軍。

translations.literal: At that time Yang Yuebin had just arrived in Jiangxi to supervise military affairs; he ordered Baotian to relieve Nanfeng; for delay he was impeached, demoted to prefect, and kept with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuebin had just arrived to supervise Jiangxi affairs and ordered Baotian to relieve Nanfeng. For delay he was impeached, demoted to prefect, and kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 會大軍克江寧，群賊擁洪秀全子福瑱逸出，由開化犯玉山，走瀘溪，寶田邀擊於新城，進至石城楊家牌，擒洪仁玕、洪仁政、黃文英等。

translations.literal: When the great army captured Jiangning, the bandits escorted Hong Xiuquan's son Fuzhen in flight; they invaded Yushan from Kaihua and fled to Luxi; Baotian intercepted them at Xincheng, advanced to Yangjiapai in Shicheng, and captured Hong Rengan, Hong Renzheng, Huang Wenying, and others.
translations.idiomatic: When Nanjing fell, rebels escorted Hong Xiuquan's son Fuzhen in flight through Kaihua into Yushan and on to Luxi. Baotian intercepted them at Xincheng, advanced to Yangjiapai in Shicheng, and captured Hong Rengan, Hong Renzheng, Huang Wenying, and others.

sentences.zh: 福瑱匿山谷中，捕得之，檻送南昌，伏誅。

translations.literal: Fuzhen hid in the mountains; he was captured, sent in a cage to Nanchang, and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhen hid in the hills, was captured, sent in a cage to Nanchang, and executed.

sentences.zh: 詔复寶田原官，予雲騎尉世職，賜黃馬褂，授貴州按察使。

translations.literal: An edict restored Baotian to his former office, granted him the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Captain, bestowed the yellow riding jacket, and appointed him provincial judicial commissioner of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored Baotian's former rank, granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Captain, bestowed the yellow riding jacket, and appointed him judicial commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 時餘賊汪海洋等走廣東，四年，寶田自平遠邀擊，降萬餘人，又扼鐵石嶺，降者二萬，諸軍合擊於嘉應州，全數蕩平。

translations.literal: At that time the remnant bandits Wang Haiyang and others fled into Guangdong; in the fourth year Baotian intercepted them from Pingyuan, accepted the surrender of more than ten thousand men, again held Tieshiling, accepted twenty thousand more surrenders, and the various armies jointly attacked at Jiaying prefecture and wiped them out entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Remnant rebels including Wang Haiyang fled into Guangdong. In the fourth year Baotian intercepted them from Pingyuan and accepted more than ten thousand surrenders, then held Tieshiling and accepted twenty thousand more. Allied armies crushed them at Jiaying and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 論功，江西軍以寶田為第一，詔以布政使記名，遇缺題奏。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed, the Jiangxi army ranked Baotian first; an edict registered him by name for provincial treasurer and ordered memorialization when a vacancy arose.
translations.idiomatic: In the merit roll the Jiangxi army ranked Baotian first. An edict registered him for provincial treasurer and ordered immediate nomination when a vacancy opened.

sentences.zh: 軍事既定，請回籍終養，允之。

translations.literal: When military affairs were settled, he requested to return home to complete mourning for his parents; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When the fighting ended, he asked to return home to complete mourning for his parents, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 貴州苗、教諸匪構亂十有餘年，東路素倚湖南援軍，自粵匪平後，議大舉剿平。

translations.literal: Miao and sectarian bandits in Guizhou had stirred rebellion for more than ten years; the eastern route had long relied on Hunan relief armies; after the Cantonese bandits were pacified, a major campaign of suppression was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Miao and sectarian rebels had ravaged Guizhou for more than ten years. The eastern front had long depended on Hunan reinforcements, and after the Taiping rebels were crushed a major pacification campaign was proposed.

sentences.zh: 先是授兆琛為貴州布政使，偕總兵周洪印率師往，積歲無功。

translations.literal: Earlier Zhao Chen had been appointed provincial treasurer of Guizhou and, together with Brigadier Zhou Hongyin, led troops there, but after years achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhao Chen had been appointed Guizhou provincial treasurer and marched there with Brigadier Zhou Hongyin, but after years they had achieved nothing.

sentences.zh: 李元度圍荊竹園，亦久不下。

translations.literal: Li Yuandu besieged Jingzhuyuan for a long time without taking it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuandu besieged Jingzhuyuan for a long time without success.

sentences.zh: 巡撫李瀚章、劉昆先後劾罷兆琛、洪印，元度亦鐫級，薦起寶田招集舊部萬人入貴州，總統東路諸軍。

translations.literal: Governors Li Hanzhang and Liu Kun in succession impeached and dismissed Zhao Chen and Hongyin; Yuandu was also reduced in rank; Baotian was recommended and recalled, gathered ten thousand of his old followers into Guizhou, and took overall command of the eastern-route armies.
translations.idiomatic: Governors Li Hanzhang and Liu Kun in turn impeached and dismissed Zhao Chen and Hongyin; Yuandu was demoted as well. Baotian was recalled, raised ten thousand veterans, entered Guizhou, and took command of the eastern armies.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，進軍石阡，荊竹園為教匪老巢，寶田審視地勢高峻，匪砦環列，惟北面平夷可掩入。

translations.literal: In the winter of the sixth year he advanced on Shiqian; Jingzhuyuan was the old nest of the sectarian bandits; Baotian surveyed the terrain and found it lofty and steep, with bandit stockades ranged in a ring, and only the level north could be used for a concealed approach.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the sixth year he advanced on Shiqian. Jingzhuyuan was the sectarians' main nest on high ground, ringed with stockades; only the level northern approach offered a concealed line of attack.

sentences.zh: 七年元旦，進攻，部將黃元果先登，諸將肉薄壘下，一日平十八砦，克荊竹園，擒斬匪首蕭桂盛、何瑞堂，其旁三十六砦相繼攻下。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day of the seventh year he attacked; his subordinate Huang Yuanguo was first to scale; the generals pressed close under the ramparts; in one day eighteen stockades were pacified, Jingzhuyuan was taken, the bandit chiefs Xiao Guisheng and He Ruitang were captured and executed, and the thirty-six neighboring stockades fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day of the seventh year he attacked. Subordinate Huang Yuanguo was first over the wall; the generals pressed the ramparts hand to hand. In one day they took eighteen stockades and Jingzhuyuan itself, captured and executed chiefs Xiao Guisheng and He Ruitang, and the thirty-six neighboring stockades fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，被珍賚。

translations.literal: When victory was reported, he received imperial rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Victory brought imperial rewards.

sentences.zh: 夏，進規寨頭。

translations.literal: In summer he advanced against Zhai tou.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he advanced against Zhai tou.

sentences.zh: 寨頭為苗疆門戶，諸苗帑賄資糧所萃，連拔東西三屯，陣斬苗酋桂金保，破援賊張臭迷，攻下台笠、丁耙塘諸砦，遂克寨頭。

translations.literal: Zhai tou was the gateway of the Miao frontier, where the various Miao collected tribute and supplies; he captured the eastern and western three tun in succession, slew the Miao chief Gui Jinbao in battle, defeated the relief bandit Zhang Choumi, stormed the stockades of Taidi and Dingbatang, and then took Zhai tou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai tou was the gateway to the Miao country, where tribes pooled tribute and supplies. He took the eastern and western three tun in succession, killed Miao chief Gui Jinbao in battle, defeated relief leader Zhang Choumi, stormed Taidi and Dingbatang, and captured Zhai tou.

sentences.zh: 分軍克天柱，斬其酋陳大六。

translations.literal: A detached force captured Tianzhu and executed its chief Chen Daliu.
translations.idiomatic: A detached column took Tianzhu and executed its chief Chen Daliu.

sentences.zh: 會丁繼母憂，回籍治喪，提督榮維善暫領其眾，尋詔奪情趣赴​​軍，進攻台拱。

translations.literal: It happened that he entered mourning for his stepmother and returned home to conduct the funeral; Provincial Military Commander Rong Weishan temporarily took command of his forces; soon an edict cut short his mourning and ordered him back to the army to advance on Taigong.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered mourning for his stepmother and returned home. Provincial Military Commander Rong Weishan temporarily took his command until an edict cut short his mourning and ordered him back to attack Taigong.

sentences.zh: 台拱苗最強，踞清江、鎮遠二城為犄角。

translations.literal: The Taigong Miao were the strongest, holding the two cities of Qingjiang and Zhenyuan as paired horns.
translations.idiomatic: The Taigong Miao were the strongest, holding Qingjiang and Zhenyuan as paired strongpoints.

sentences.zh: 寶田請增兵萬人，按察使黃潤昌、道員鄧子垣領之出晃州為北路，寶田自當南路，令榮維善用雕剿法，轉戰山谷間，破諸苗砦，漸近鎮遠。

translations.literal: Baotian requested ten thousand additional troops; Provincial Judicial Commissioner Huang Runchang and Circuit Intendant Deng Ziyuan led them out from Huangzhou as the northern route; Baotian himself took the southern route; he ordered Rong Weishan to use the eagle-hunt suppression method, fighting through the mountain valleys, breaking the Miao stockades, and gradually approaching Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Baotian asked for ten thousand more troops. Judicial Commissioner Huang Runchang and Circuit Intendant Deng Ziyuan led them from Huangzhou on the northern route while Baotian took the south. He had Rong Weishan use swift encirclement tactics in the valleys, storming Miao stockades and closing on Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 潤昌、子垣由思州進攻鎮遠府城，克之。

translations.literal: Runchang and Ziyuan advanced from Sinan against the Zhenyuan prefectural city and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Runchang and Ziyuan advanced from Sinan, took the Zhenyuan prefectural city, and held it.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，維善連破董敖、公鵝兩隘，遂克清江廳城。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year Weishan in succession broke the two passes of Dong'ao and Gong'e, then captured the Qingjiang subprefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year Weishan stormed the passes at Dong'ao and Gong'e, then took the Qingjiang subprefectural city.

sentences.zh: 兩軍合趨黃飄，山地狹峻，人行頂趾相接，遇伏。

translations.literal: The two armies converged on Huangpiao; the mountain terrain was narrow and steep, men marched toe to heel, and they met an ambush.
translations.idiomatic: Both columns converged on Huangpiao along a narrow mountain track where men marched toe to heel and walked into an ambush.

sentences.zh: 維善軍疾行先出險，潤昌軍誤以為陷伏中，爭道相擠，為賊所乘，潤昌、子垣皆戰歿。

translations.literal: Weishan's army marched swiftly and emerged from danger first; Runchang's army mistakenly thought them trapped in ambush, struggled for the road and crowded one another, were exploited by the bandits, and both Runchang and Ziyuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Weishan's column marched fast and cleared the danger first. Runchang's men mistook them for trapped in ambush, crowded the path, and were overrun; Runchang and Ziyuan both fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 維善聞變，率二百人馳救，被圍，為苗所擒，遇害。

translations.literal: Weishan heard of the disaster, led two hundred men in a gallop to the rescue, was surrounded, captured by the Miao, and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the disaster, Weishan galloped to the rescue with two hundred men, was surrounded, captured by the Miao, and killed.

sentences.zh: 於是苗氛复熾。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Miao rebellion flared up again.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao rebellion flared up again.

sentences.zh: 張秀眉犯巴冶，寶田親督軍擊走之，進克稿米，令龔繼昌、蘇元春破苗寨，擊走張臭迷等，分軍守鎮遠、施秉。

translations.literal: Zhang Xiumei invaded Baye; Baotian personally directed the army to drive him off, advanced to capture Gaomi, ordered Gong Jichang and Su Yuanchun to break Miao stockades and drive off Zhang Choumi and others, and detached troops to hold Zhenyuan and Shibing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xiumei invaded Baye; Baotian personally led the army to drive him off, took Gaomi, sent Gong Jichang and Su Yuanchun to storm Miao stockades and rout Zhang Choumi, and posted detachments at Zhenyuan and Shibing.

sentences.zh: 時以寶田軍苦戰年餘，尚未深入，議罷其軍，劉昆仍主專任，復增兵萬人，分三路進。

translations.literal: At that time, because Baotian's army had fought bitterly for more than a year without penetrating deep, some proposed disbanding it; Liu Kun still insisted on sole responsibility, again added ten thousand troops, and advanced in three routes.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year of hard fighting without penetrating deep, some proposed disbanding Baotian's army. Liu Kun kept him in sole command, added ten thousand men, and advanced in three columns.

sentences.zh: 九年，會攻施洞，克之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year they jointly attacked Shidong and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year they jointly attacked and captured Shidong.

sentences.zh: 苗走九股河，白洗苗來援，擊敗之。

translations.literal: The Miao fled to the Jiugu River; the Baixi Miao came to their aid and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao fled to the Jiugu River; Baixi Miao reinforcements were defeated.

sentences.zh: 進攻台拱，破革夷諸砦，薄台拱城下，苗棄城走，克之，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: Advancing on Taigong, they broke the Geyi stockades, pressed to the walls of Taigong, the Miao abandoned the city and fled, it was captured, and he was given the first-rank cap button.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Taigong, they stormed the Geyi stockades, pressed the walls, and took the city when the Miao fled. He received the first-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 進軍九股河，分別剿撫，凡平黑苗砦二百餘所。

translations.literal: The army advanced to the Jiugu River, suppressing and pacifying in turn, and in all pacified more than two hundred Hei Miao stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced to the Jiugu River, alternating suppression and pacification, and cleared more than two hundred Hei Miao stockades.

sentences.zh: 雞講、丹江苗皆請歸化。

translations.literal: The Miao of Jijiang and Danjiang all petitioned to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao of Jijiang and Danjiang all petitioned to submit.

sentences.zh: 十年，進攻凱里，一鼓而下。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he attacked Kaili and took it at the first assault.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he attacked Kaili and took it at the first assault.

sentences.zh: 苗潰走雷公山，麕眾六七萬人，黃茅嶺、雷口坪、九眼塘、燕子窩諸寨皆絕險，寶田督諸軍冒暑入山，合擊張臭迷，斬馘三萬，燔其廬舍，剿洗一空。

translations.literal: The Miao broke and fled to Leigong Mountain, gathering sixty or seventy thousand men; the stockades of Huangmaoling, Leikouping, Jiuyantang, and Yanzowo were all extremely perilous; Baotian directed the armies into the mountains in the summer heat, jointly attacked Zhang Choumi, killed and decapitated thirty thousand, burned their dwellings, and swept the area clean.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao broke and fled to Leigong Mountain, gathering sixty or seventy thousand men in stockades at Huangmaoling, Leikouping, Jiuyantang, and Yanzowo. Baotian led the armies into the mountains in summer heat, crushed Zhang Choumi, killed thirty thousand, burned their dwellings, and swept the region clean.

sentences.zh: 駐軍施洞口，寶田遽病風痺，乞假醫療，命部將龔繼昌、蘇元春、唐本有、謝蘭階分統其軍。

translations.literal: The army camped at Shidongkou; Baotian suddenly fell ill with wind paralysis, begged leave for medical treatment, and ordered his subordinates Gong Jichang, Su Yuanchun, Tang Benyou, and Xie Lanjie to divide command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: The army camped at Shidongkou. Baotian suddenly fell ill with paralysis, took medical leave, and divided his army among Gong Jichang, Su Yuanchun, Tang Benyou, and Xie Lanjie.

sentences.zh: 軍事進止機宜，仍禀命於寶田。

translations.literal: Advances, halts, and tactical decisions in military affairs were still reported to Baotian for orders.
translations.idiomatic: All advances, halts, and tactical decisions still required Baotian's approval.

sentences.zh: 十一年，三路進兵，凱北以北悉定。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year three routes advanced; north of Kaili all was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year three columns advanced and pacified everything north of Kaili.

sentences.zh: 合攻烏雅坡，諸酋皆在，以長圍困之。

translations.literal: They jointly attacked Wuyapo; all the chiefs were there and were trapped by a long encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly attacked Wuyapo, where all the chiefs had gathered, and hemmed them in with a long siege.

sentences.zh: 迭戰，斬九大白、岩大五於陣，先後降者數万。

translations.literal: In successive battles they slew Jiudabai and Yandawu in the field; those who surrendered in succession numbered tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In successive battles they killed Jiudabai and Yandawu in the field, and tens of thousands surrendered in turn.

sentences.zh: 四月，擒張秀眉、楊大六、金大五等，檻送長沙，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month they captured Zhang Xiumei, Yang Daliu, Jin Dawu, and others, sent them in cages to Changsha, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month they captured Zhang Xiumei, Yang Daliu, Jin Dawu, and others, sent them in cages to Changsha, and executed them.

sentences.zh: 張臭迷先逸，捕得戮之。

translations.literal: Zhang Choumi had fled earlier; he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Choumi had fled earlier; he was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 諸酋或降或斬，無脫者。

translations.literal: The chiefs either surrendered or were executed; none escaped.
translations.idiomatic: The chiefs either surrendered or were killed; none escaped.

sentences.zh: 苗疆平，詔晉寶田騎都尉世職，家居養疴。

translations.literal: The Miao frontier was pacified; an edict promoted Baotian to hereditary Cavalry Commandant and he lived at home to nurse his illness.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao frontier was pacified. An edict promoted Baotian to hereditary Cavalry Commandant, and he retired home to recover his health.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，詔以寶田前擒洪福瑱功，命曾國荃繪其像以進。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu an edict cited Baotian's former merit in capturing Hong Fuzhen and ordered Zeng Guoquan to paint his portrait and present it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Guangxu an edict cited Baotian's capture of Hong Fuzhen and ordered Zeng Guoquan to paint his portrait for presentation at court.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒，贈太子少保，優恤。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died; posthumously he was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and generous funeral honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he died and was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with generous funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 原籍及江西、貴州建專祠。

translations.literal: Dedicated shrines were built in his native place and in Jiangxi and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dedicated shrines were built in his native place and in Jiangxi and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 論曰：貴州之匪，總名有六：曰苗匪、教匪，曰黃號、白號，其小者曰槓匪、仲匪，其他濫練、游勇、逆回、悍夷，揭竿踵起，不可悉數。

translations.literal: The commentary says: The bandits of Guizhou fall under six general names: Miao bandits and sectarian bandits; Yellow-Banner and White-Banner; the lesser categories are gang bandits and Zhong bandits; besides these, irregular militia, roaming braves, rebel Hui, and fierce barbarians rose one after another with weapons in hand, beyond full reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Guizhou's rebels fell under six broad categories: Miao and sectarian rebels; Yellow- and White-Banner sectarians; and lesser types such as gang and Zhong rebels. Beyond these, irregular militia, roaming braves, rebel Hui, and fierce tribesmen rose in endless succession.

sentences.zh: 始於咸豐四年，無兵無餉，不能制也。

translations.literal: It began in the fourth year of Xianfeng; without troops or funds, the government could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: The trouble began in the fourth year of Xianfeng. Without troops or funds, the government could not control them.

sentences.zh: 韓超有辦賊之才，久屈下僚，事權不屬。

translations.literal: Han Chao had the talent to handle bandits but long remained in subordinate posts without authority belonging to him.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chao had the talent to suppress bandits but long remained a subordinate without real authority.

sentences.zh: 田興恕入黔，兵威始振，超亦驟起，未久相繼去。

translations.literal: When Tian Xingyu entered Guizhou, military prestige first revived; Chao also rose abruptly, but before long they left in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When Tian Xingyu entered Guizhou the army's prestige revived, and Chao rose with him, but both soon departed in turn.

sentences.zh: 張亮基治黔數年，亦僅補苴。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangji governed Guizhou for several years and achieved only patchwork repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangji governed Guizhou for years and achieved only patchwork repairs.

sentences.zh: 中原大定，曾國籓乃議以湖南兵力、餉力為平黔根本，而駱秉章亦令劉岳昭剿黔北以保川邊。

translations.literal: When the central plains were largely settled, Zeng Guofan then proposed that Hunan's military strength and fiscal strength be the foundation for pacifying Guizhou, while Luo Bingzhang also ordered Liu Yuezhao to suppress northern Guizhou to secure the Sichuan border.
translations.idiomatic: Once the central plains were largely pacified, Zeng Guofan proposed that Hunan's troops and funds be the foundation for pacifying Guizhou, while Luo Bingzhang ordered Liu Yuezhao to clear northern Guizhou and secure the Sichuan border.

sentences.zh: 後專倚席寶田，戡定苗疆。

translations.literal: Later reliance was placed solely on Xi Baotian to pacify the Miao frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Later the campaign relied chiefly on Xi Baotian to pacify the Miao frontier.

sentences.zh: 自周達武以川兵、川餉濟黔之不及，曾璧光賴之以竟全功。

translations.literal: From the time Zhou Dawu used Sichuan troops and Sichuan funds to supply what Guizhou lacked, Zeng Biguang relied on this to complete the full achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Once Zhou Dawu supplied what Guizhou lacked with Sichuan troops and funds, Zeng Biguang relied on that support to finish the pacification.

sentences.zh: 蓋閱二十年而後大定。

translations.literal: In all, only after twenty years was there great pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Only after twenty years was the province fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 古云：「蠻夷之人，先叛後服。

translations.literal: The ancients said: "Barbarian peoples rebel first and submit afterward.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said, "Barbarian peoples rebel first and submit afterward.

sentences.zh: 」蓋以地勢使然。

translations.literal: " This is because terrain makes it so.
translations.idiomatic: " That is the nature of the terrain.

sentences.zh: 然使若韓超者早膺疆寄，其延禍或不致如是之甚。

translations.literal: Yet if men like Han Chao had early received frontier commissions, the prolongation of disaster might not have reached such severity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet if men like Han Chao had been given frontier command early on, the disaster might not have dragged on so severely.

sentences.zh: 弭亂之道，在得其人，用人之道，必盡其才，固古今不爽者爾。

translations.literal: The way to quell disorder lies in obtaining the right man; the way to employ men requires fully using their talents — this is what has never failed from ancient times to the present.
translations.idiomatic: The way to end disorder is to find the right man; the way to employ men is to use their talents fully — a truth that has never changed.
